title: Bug Bounty Finder Configuration
description: Find public bug bounty programs and security disclosure contacts for a company or domain.

query.title: Company / Domain
query.description: Company name or domain to search. Examples: 'shopify', 'shopify.com', 'github', 'tesla.com'. The actor searches HackerOne + Bugcrowd by the query AND fetches /.well-known/security.txt from the domain (if it looks like one).

sources.title: Sources to query
sources.description: Pick which sources to query. Default = all enabled. Each source is independent.

additionalDomains.title: Additional domains for security.txt
additionalDomains.description: Extra domains to fetch security.txt from (e.g., subsidiaries, brand variants). Example: ['github.com', 'github.io', 'githubusercontent.com'].

limit.title: Max programs per source
limit.description: Cap results from HackerOne / Bugcrowd to this number (most queries return < 10).
